documents.content: Dx: atopic dermatitis L20.9. IGA 3. BSA 18%. Prescriber specialty: dermatology. Prior therapies: 'topical steroids, tacrolimus — inadequate response.' No concurrent biologic or JAK inhibitor.

03/02/2026: Start triamcinolone 0.1% cream BID to affected areas. 04/20/2026 f/u: minimal improvement after 7 wks, IGA 3, d/c triamcinolone. Start tacrolimus 0.1% ointment BID. 05/01/2026: confirmed pt started tacrolimus 04/21. 06/30/2026 f/u: tacrolimus x ~10 wks, mild burning but tolerated, inadequate response, IGA 3, BSA 18%. Plan: biologic, dupilumab.
